detail.inlineDescriptionPlaceholder: Describe this project in one line
detail.domainRowsLegendCaption: The number on the right is how many concepts live in that domain. The bar shows how they split between capabilities and elements, and clicking a row unfolds every capability inside it.

detail.domainOverlapNote: Concepts in several domains are counted once per domain, so these rows can sum higher than the counts above.
detail.surfaceOntologyEmpty: No domains or capabilities yet. Make the first domain on the map.
detail.surfaceLibraryEmpty: This folder holds no sources and no wiki pages.
detail.surfaceHarnessHolds: The instructions, structure and sensors an agent works under, read from the folder's source tree in the desktop app.
detail.surfaceFolderScope: Sources and wiki pages count the whole folder
detail.bodyContinue: Keep reading in the Ontology document
detail.briefAskTitle: Hand the overview to an agent
detail.briefAskUnstructured: This overview is not laid out yet. An agent can read the map and rewrite it as four sections (what it does · how work flows · where it is uneven · where to look next). The result stays after you review it in the Library.
detail.briefAskStructured: To lay it out again, give an agent the same instructions. The result stays after you review it in the Library.
detail.briefAskCopied: Copied: paste it into the agent chat
detail.briefAskAgent: Opens the agent here to read the map and rewrite the overview in four sections. It asks before writing to the file, and the result can be reviewed in the Library.
detail.briefPrompt: Lay out the overview of {slug}. First read the map with get_concept("{slug}", body: "full") and query_ontology('{'operation: "project_map", project: "{slug}"'}'), and check the evidence in the domain, capability and element documents. Then rewrite the body of {doc} under four ## headings: 1) What it does (two or three sentences), 2) How work flows (a numbered list, each step naming its domains as [[domains/…]] wikilinks), 3) Where it is uneven (bullets: where capabilities outnumber elements and the reverse), 4) Where to look next (bullets, each with a wikilink to its evidence document). Write nothing the map does not support. Before writing, pass the mtime from get_concept as expected_mtime and change only the body with patch_concept. I will review it in the Library.
detail.connectedEmpty: Not connected to any other project yet.
detail.connectedEmptyHint: Create a second project document and link the two to see it here.
detail.handoffDesc: Paste the copied text into an AI tool like Claude or Cursor: it picks up this project's map and continues from here.
detail.handoffCopiedLabel: Copied: paste into your AI chat
detail.saveErrorConflict: This project file was changed first by another editor or AI agent. Refresh and save again.
detail.readOnlyBadge: View only. Open your folder to edit the name and description here.

errors.malformed: Required qualification artifacts are missing or unreadable. No plan or approval is shown.
errors.project_mismatch: This result belongs to a different project. Open the result for this project.
errors.digest_mismatch: These files come from different check runs. Open results from a single run only.
errors.plan_mismatch: The reviewed plan and writable plan differ. Writing stays blocked.

constructionReview.planDigest: Plan fingerprint (a short code that detects changes): {digest}
constructionReview.sourceDigest: Source fingerprint (a short code that detects changes): {digest}
constructionReview.writePlanMissing: Write plan is not available yet. This is not a plan mismatch.
constructionReview.draftHint: Refine the CQ, evidence location, and exact plan inside this result. The source verdict and vault never change.
constructionReview.draftDirty: The review draft changed. It is not saved, and it must pass verification again before anything is written.
constructionReview.draftClean: The review draft matches the original result.
constructionReview.draftNoWrite: Session only · no auto-save or transfer
